THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 01.07.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C) NO. 24066 OF 2025  2  2025:KER:47912  C.S.DIAS, J.
 ---------------------------------------
 WP(C) No.24066 OF 2025  -----------------------------------------
 Dated this the 1st day of July, 2025  JUDGMENT
The writ petition is filed to quash Ext.P3 notice issued by the 2nd respondent and direct him to consider Ext.P4 representation submitted by the petitioner.
2. The petitioner is residing within the territorial limits of the 1st respondent Panchayat.
The petitioner had carried out minor repairs in his residence.
Now the 2 nd respondent issued Ext.P3 notice to the petitioner pointing out certain differences in the construction.
Even though the petitioner submitted Ext.P4 representation before the 2 nd respondent on 11.06.2025, the same has not been considered till date.
The petitioner is apprehensive that the respondents may take coercive proceedings pursuant to Ext.P3 notice.
Heard; the learned counsel for the petitioner.
In view of the limited relief that I propose of pass, I dispense with notice to the respondents.

On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, especially that Ext.P4 representation is pending consideration before the 2nd respondent and the petitioner has not been afforded an opportunity of being heard pursuant to Ext.P3 notice, I direct the 2nd respondent to consider and dispose of Ext.P4 representation, in accordance with law,
and as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within 60 days from the date of production of a copy of this judgment, after affording the petitioner an opportunity of being heard.
Until orders are passed on Ext.P4 representation, the respondents are directed to defer coercive proceedings pursuant to Ext.P3 notice.
